scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e:prepare && playwright test
scripts.e2e:prepare: node scripts/reset-e2e-state.mjs && cross-env CI=1 CLOUDFLARE_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/xdg WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/e2e-prepare.log wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.e2e:server: cross-env CLOUDFLARE_VITE_PERSIST_PATH=.wrangler/e2e-state CLOUDFLARE_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/xdg WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/e2e-wrangler.log vite preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build && cross-env CLOUDFLARE_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/xdg WRANGLER_WRITE_LOGS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/deploy-dry-run.log wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json --dry-run
